findings.statement: Marketing overspent its budget by 152,200, which is the largest overspend among all departments.
findings.method: SQL join and subtraction to calculate overspend per department, then ordered by overspend descending
findings.code: SELECT b.department, b.budget, a.actual, (a.actual - b.budget) AS overspend FROM budget_2025_budget b JOIN budget_2025_actual a ON b.department = a.department ORDER BY overspend DESC

data_quality_notes: No null values in either table
No duplicate rows in either table
All department names are strings with no type issues
All budget and actual values are integers
assumptions: Budget and actual figures are for the same fiscal year (2025)
Overspend is calculated as actual minus budget (positive = overspent, negative = underspent)
limitations: No information on whether these are the only departments or a sample of all departments
